news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹24.83 (down from ₹32.46 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹249.3b (up 2.3% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹16.9b (down 24% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 6.8% (down from 9.0% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 7.4%. Revenue is forecast to grow 11% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Consumer Durables industry in India.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.32. Net income: ₹896.7m (up ₹896.7m from 3Q 2025). Revenue missed analyst estimates by 7.4%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 61%. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Consumer Durables industry in India.

news.title: LG Electronics India Limited Announces Appointment of Jongha Hwang as Chief Strategy Officer, Effective January 16, 2026
news.body: LG Electronics India Limited appointed Mr. Jongha Hwang as Chief Strategy Officer (CSO) of the Company as Senior Management Personnel with effect from January 16, 2026. Mr. Jongha Hwang holds a Master’s Degree in Business Administration (MBA) from aSSIST University, South Korea. He has over 29 years of extensive experience across strategy and market intelligence functions. Mr. Jongha Hwang has previously worked with LG Electronics Inc. (Korea), where he was responsible for Market Intelligence and analysis of industry trends aligned with the Company’s strategic objectives.

news.title: aiMotive and LG to Unveil Advanced Integrated IVI/ADAS Contractor At CES 2026
news.body: aiMotive in collaboration with LG, will introduce a next-generation High-Performing Computing (HPC) Lite platform at CES 2026. Designed to support advanced driver assistance and in-vehicle experiences, the platform integrates LG's In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) system and Advanced Driver assistance System (ADAS) in a single controller. aiMotive and LG have been working together on the new HPC platform since May of this year. The HPC platform acts as a central processing unit for the vehicle, consolidating multiple functions into LG's HPC Electronic Control Unit (ECU). The ECU features aiMotive's aiDrive software solution.
